TASK: Fix audit defects F2 and F9 in ui/src/lib/agentTitle.ts.
CONTEXT: F2 - lines 121-135: agent detection uses agent.pattern.test(lower) matching ANYWHERE in the title (patterns like /\bcursor\b/i, /\bpi\b/i, /\bomo\b/i), so a title like 'git commit -m "fix cursor position"' is misclassified as the cursor agent even when the anchored taskPattern fails. Restrict detection to a strict prefix / leading token of the title so mid-string matches NEVER classify as an agent.
